nodes.label: Meta-Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Model Harnesses
nodes.author: Yoonho Lee et al.

nodes.label: Meta-Harness System (coding-agent proposer with filesystem access)
nodes.rationale: Gives a coding-agent proposer full filesystem access to prior harness source code, scores, and complete execution traces rather than compressed feedback, because a harness is a stateful long-horizon program where compressed feedback discards the information needed to trace a failure to its cause.

nodes.label: Raw-Trace vs Summary/Score Interface Ablation (Table 3)
nodes.rationale: Isolates whether raw execution traces specifically (not merely more information) drive accuracy gains; summarization performs no better than scores alone, showing summarization actively discards causal signal.

hyperedges.label: Granular Diagnostic Signal Over Compressed Feedback
